Observed and modeled values

Source: R/methods.R
as.data.frame.joinpoint.Rd

Observed values, standard errors, the supplied counts and populations, modeled values (the fitted trend, with covariates at their average) for the selected model (or all models) and flags for excluded points, zero counts replaced by 0.5 in the observed value and joinpoints.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'joinpoint'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, model = "final", ...)

Arguments

x

A joinpoint object.

row.names, optional

Ignored.

model

"final", a number of joinpoints, or "all".

...

Ignored.

Value

A data frame.

Examples

tb <- subset(us_mortality, cause == "Tuberculosis")
fit <- joinpoint(tb, year, rate, kmax = 2, ci_method = "parametric")
head(as.data.frame(fit))
